tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Stores this organization owns, with status, visibility, radius and activation. Use the store id to check coverage and book. Filter by status or visibility; page with starting_after.

tools.name: register_store
tools.description: Register a store: a real place whose owner promises to load the robot. Send the name, the address, at least one alert channel the store owns (relay, webhook, sms or voice), and optionally where the robot parks (robot_spot), hours inside 10:00 to 22:00, the coverage radius (default 2 miles, maximum 5

tools.name: update_store
tools.description: Change a store you own: name, address, robot spot, hours, radius, visibility, alert channels, loading notes, perishables setting or external_ref; status pauses (paused) and resumes (live) a store. A pending store becomes live only through the activation check. Changing a live store's address or robo

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Live open stores near a drop-off address, nearest first, with whether each one's coverage radius reaches the address. Any account may book from an open store with an order_ref the store recognizes.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Can this store deliver to this address at this ready time? Send store_id (a registered store) and dropoff_address; ready_at defaults to now. Checks the store's status, hours and coverage radius, the 5-mile network maximum and the zone, and returns the $2.99 fee and the arrival window. Capacity is an

tools.name: book_delivery
tools.description: Book a $2.99 robot delivery from a registered store in one call. Send store_id, dropoff_address and dropoff_phone; order_ref is the store's own order number (required at an open store); ready_at starts the 2-hour promise and defaults to now. The answer is yes or no now: a decline carries retry_after

tools.name: track_delivery
tools.description: The current Delivery, including store_id, store_name, order_ref, ready_at, promised_by and the pickup and return timestamps. Test deliveries are simulated.

tools.name: cancel_delivery
tools.description: Cancel before pickup; a successful cancellation releases the full fee hold. The owner of an open store may use this on another account's booking inside the decline window: that records store.declined and cancels with cancel_reason store_declined. tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Proof of a delivered Delivery, with its store_id and order_ref. Sandbox proof is explicitly marked simulated.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: The Wallet balance for this organization and environment: available, held, this month's spend and the auto top-up setting. Reading only.

tools.name: request_topup
tools.description: Ask for a Wallet top-up of amount_credited cents (2000 to 1000000). The reply carries a signed confirmation link that a person completes in Console; no money moves until they do, and the link expires after 24 hours. Track it with GET /v1/topups/request/{id}.
